scripts.dev: npm run build && bash -c "trap 'kill 0' SIGINT; node scripts/generate-html.js --watch & vite --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: npm run build:index && npm run build:loop && npm run build:scenario && npm run build:export && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:loop: npm run generate-html && BUILD_ENTRY=loop.html vite build
scripts.build:scenario: npm run generate-html && BUILD_ENTRY=scenario.html vite build
scripts.test:e2e:quick-check: VITE_DISABLE_EXTERNAL_CLIPBOARD_CHECK=true start-server-and-test 'npm run dev:test' http://localhost:3456 'cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/00-app-loading-check.cy.js --headless --browser firefox --config baseUrl=http://localhost:3456 --env LOGGING_MODE=silent'
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:quick-check && npm run test:e2e:all
scripts.test:e2e:interactive: start-server-and-test 'npm run dev:test' http://localhost:3456 'cypress open --browser firefox --config baseUrl=http://localhost:3456'
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
